scope: Isolated Edge, synthetic API and optional saved public Springer DOM. No user profile, live publisher fetch or real AI accuracy test.

results.name: Springer reading-companion size/format duplicates collapse to five complete captions and one linked table
Distinct panels and query identities survive; small download controls disappear but real SVG charts remain
Link discovery rejects citations, external origins, binary downloads and already readable tables; repeated links merge
Linked table parser preserves complete 54-by-5 grid, captions, notes and Markdown
Span expansion retains table values and accessible captions
Remote scripts, image handlers and frames stay inert while hidden/script text is excluded
Challenge pages, wrong table numbers and ambiguous different same-number tables fail explicitly
Saved real Springer article has exactly five figures, one table link and full descriptions

Table export and explicit paper Q&A include all rows without selecting an image

Downloads only use stored same-origin links and reject invalid indices and privileged page callers
HTTP errors, redirects, wrong MIME and oversized declared/streamed table pages fail without following redirects

Source changes during a table download reject stale results before they reach material
